title: Law to fight e-bike battery fires with inspections
summary: This law would require the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection and the Fire Department to create a targeted outreach, inspection and enforcement plan by March 1, 2027 to reduce fire risks from unsafe powered bicycles, mobility devices and their batteries. The plan would prioritize risky locations and sellers, address unsafe online sales, and promote safe charging and storage practices. Starting April 1, 2027, the city would also report quarterly on related fires, inspections and enforcement actions.
